tools.description: Report corpus size, year coverage, and last-harvest time.
tools.name: e-print-mcp_corpus_stats

tools.description:
Return a temporary URL for an intact original PDF or PostScript file.
A missing original is fetched inline
in standalone mode or queued for the cluster's dedicated fetcher. The
cluster waits briefly so the initial call normally returns the URL on a
direct-fetch success; slower fallbacks return a queue status. Once returned,
the client should download the signed HTTPS URL from the server's cache.
tools.name: e-print-mcp_eprint_file

tools.description:
Read a paper's BODY from the local cache, not just its abstract.

In standalone mode, the first call downloads and caches the PDF. In the
cluster, it queues a missing PDF and waits briefly for the dedicated
fetcher; the initial call normally returns the requested text when the
direct path succeeds, otherwise it returns a queue status. Responses
link to the archive or a verified original. PostScript text is extracted
by an isolated worker and cached; if extraction fails, the original PS
download remains available. Always pass `query` -- these are full
papers. `ref` is accepted as an alias for paper_id for symmetry with the
NIST tools.
tools.name: e-print-mcp_eprint_fulltext

tools.description:
Fetch full metadata and the abstract for one ePrint paper by ID
(e.g. "2024/1234"), including its archive link and any cached original's format.
tools.name: e-print-mcp_get_eprint

tools.description: List the newest ePrint submissions, optionally filtered by topic.
tools.name: e-print-mcp_recent_eprint

tools.description:
Refresh the entire local corpus incrementally, then rebuild its index.

This tool takes no parameters. It is not a targeted per-paper refresh and
may take a while when many new archive records are available.
tools.name: e-print-mcp_refresh_eprint

tools.description:
Search the Cryptology ePrint Archive corpus by topic, title, or keyword.

Domain acronyms expand automatically (LWE -> learning with errors, MPCitH
-> MPC-in-the-Head, etc.).  Supports FTS5 syntax directly when you want
control -- quoted phrases, AND/OR/NOT, prefix wildcards like "latt*".
Results include archive links and verified formats for cached originals.
Use eprint_file to resolve and download an uncached original (PDF or PS).
Set abstracts=true only after narrowing; it costs a lot of tokens.
tools.name: e-print-mcp_search_eprint
